arms.scope: Complete frozen BEAM snapshot; all arm ID/rank/score correctness

explicit_temporal_requests.scope: Additional request-shape validation only. Two official queries with explicit data-derived windows; excluded from the 20-question BEAM latency sample and any accuracy score.

term_selector.source: Original select_selective_bm25_tokens plus native prepare_bm25_text cap versus PG compatibility helper. Includes stopwords, duplicates, empty tokens, and SQL-error fallback.

historical109_regression.scope: Historical 109-world-fact archive restored in separate experimental database, not the active LoCoMo environment.

original_http_model_input_audit.scope: Audit whether bare PG-entry sessions produced the same workload as original initialized HTTP sessions; outside measured intervals.

native_model_and_response.scope: Controlled full native Recall HTTP. Real Volcano request time and actual local BGE included; retrieval uses the same frozen real query vectors. No reader/judge.
native_model_and_response.bootstrap_note: 10,000 resamples of the 20 question-level average paired differences; conditional on one bank, one host and this schedule; not a cross-conversation confidence interval.

pg_audit.method: PG log_min_duration_statement=0 only for two untimed warmups, then -1 before every measured round. Dedicated PG only.
